name: LND
description: LND is the Lightning Network Daemon, a complete Lightning Network node implementation. This template starts LND on Bitcoin mainnet with the Neutrino light-client backend by default, exposes the Lightning P2P, gRPC, and REST ports, and persists the full /root/.lnd directory. LND can custody real bitcoin; back up the wallet seed and static channel backup before funding channels.

paths.name: LND Data
paths.description: Persistent LND data, wallet, TLS certificate, macaroons, channel database, logs, and static channel backup.

ports.name: Lightning P2P Port
ports.description: Lightning peer-to-peer port. Forward this port from your router if this node should accept inbound public peers.

ports.name: gRPC API Port
ports.description: LND gRPC API port. Requires TLS and macaroons.

ports.name: REST API Port
ports.description: LND REST API port. Requires TLS and macaroons. Host port defaults to 8081 to avoid common web UI port conflicts.
